embeds.title: Pluto Documentation
embeds.description:
Pluto is a full-fledged betting app that creates a competitive sports betting environment.
# Getting Started
1. Run the `/odds` command to view current betting odds.
2. Use the `/bet` command to place bets, starting with a balance of $50.
3. Use the `/dailyclaim` command every 24 hours to get free money if you run out of funds.

**💜 [Support Pluto](https://www.patreon.com/fenix_)**
**📒 [Documentation](https://docs.pluto.fearandesire.com)**
